item.title: September Fed Rate Hike Was a Mistake, Miran Says
item.description: Former Federal Reserve Governor Stephen Miran says raising interest rates in September was a mistake and not necessary. Miran also says he's enthusiastic about cutting back on forward guidance from the Fed even if it raises the risk premium. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: RBC Hires Gaut From Mizuho to Head Strategic Equity Dealmaking
item.description: Royal Bank of Canada has hired equity capital markets banker Mariano Gaut from Mizuho Financial Group Inc. to lead the structuring of corporate derivatives and origination of convertible bond deals globally.
